title: Sublingual Caruncle Taste Buds Drive Taste Perception and Salivary Reflexes
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Ahead of Print.
Taste buds (TBs) are the fundamental units of taste perception and are distributed throughout the oral cavity, including the tongue, soft palate, epiglottis, pharynx, and retromolar pad. Despite their widespread presence, a complete and systematic ...
